description: Chief Secretary's Office of the Southern Province - Order to Confer the Power of the Commissioner of Co-operative Development of the Southern Province
categorisation: This gazette contains both a named individual (Udalamaththaa Gamage Dayawansha Ariyathilaka) with his detailed ministerial title and portfolio responsibilities (Minister of Agriculture, Agrarian Development, Irrigation, Water Supply and Drainage, Food Supply and Distribution, Trade and Co-operative Development), AND it involves the conferment of specific powers to other named individuals (Ambagaha Duwage Pearly, Modaragamage Don Greta Mariya Mallika, Weerathun Arachchige Michael Padmasiri) with detailed descriptions of their new responsibilities under various sections of the Co-operative Societies Law. This meets the criteria for Hybrid (Type 3) as it includes both government personnel and detailed portfolio responsibilities.
